gloss: to praise to the skies; to heap praise on

definitions.gloss: to praise to the skies; to heap praise on
definitions.explanation: To praise someone or something excessively or effusively. The auxiliary ちぎる adds a sense of doing something with great intensity or abandon.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{褒|ほ}めちぎられた。
examples.english: I was praised lavishly by the teacher.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{料理|りょうり}を{皆|みんな}が{褒|ほ}めちぎった。
examples.english: Everyone heaped praise on her cooking.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}{評論家|ひょうろんか}たちがこぞってその{新作|しんさく}を{褒|ほ}めちぎっている。
examples.english: Film critics are all praising the new movie to the skies.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
Godan verb (る→ら/り/る/れ/ろ). The ちぎる auxiliary attaches to the masu-stem of verbs and means to do something intensely or without restraint.

PATTERNS:
- AをBが{褒|ほ}めちぎる (B praises A effusively)
- {褒|ほ}めちぎられる (to be praised lavishly — passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}する (to give rave reviews — similar intensity but more formal)
- {褒|ほ}めちぎって{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる (to praise and flatter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{褒|ほ}める means simply "to praise." {褒|ほ}めちぎる adds the nuance of excessive or effusive praise. {絶賛|ぜっさん}する is a more formal equivalent often used in media and reviews.
